title: The comparison box W = p⁻¹(C_s) ∩ q⁻¹(B_ρ(0)) is open, relatively compact in ℝ^P, and contains the slab {|⟨g_i,·⟩| ≤ r} ∩ q⁻¹(K) for K ⊆ B_ρ(0)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be orthonormal with span G := span{g_1, …, g_k}, p := G.starProjection, q := G^⊥.starProjection, and let r, s, ρ ∈ ℝ with r < s. Put C_s := {x ∈ ℝ^P : |⟨g_i, x⟩| < s for all i} and W := p⁻¹(C_s) ∩ q⁻¹(B_ρ(0)). Then (i) W is open; (ii) W ⊂⊂ ℝ^P, i.e. CompactlyContained W univ (closure W is compact and contained in ℝ^P); (iii) for every K ⊆ B_ρ(0): {x ∈ ℝ^P : |⟨g_i, x⟩| ≤ r for all i} ∩ q⁻¹(K) ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (r s ρ : ℝ), Orthonormal ℝ g → r < s → IsOpen ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ) ∧ CompactlyContained ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ) univ ∧ ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), K ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ → {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' K ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g)).starProjection ⁻¹' {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| < s} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' ball (0 : Euclid P) ρ
